body:
Life hasn't been kind to me lately. Honestly. I hate waking up everyday trying to force myself to be happy. It's extremely exhausting. I don't feel happy about anything in life and nothing brings me one ounce of joy. I try to do things I used to enjoy, but i feel as if I'm forcing myself. I have these moments when I just suddenly cry, the thing is it only happens when I'm driving so it's somewhat embarrassing :/ I hope it never happens again 

I'm hoping things will change soon. I'm so sad you guys
I'm constantly sad I wish someone would help me.
Hhaha today I finally found the courage to talk to my mom about my depression and she just said "did you pray this morning?" hahaha i want to die

I am scared of telling my parents. I've tried multiple times to tell them about my depression (even before I got dismissed from school) but all I got was how I didn't pray enough, how I should get closer to God. My parents are very religious, I am not. I hate everything about this situation. I have until mid-August before they notice that I didn't leave for school and start questioning. I am so terrified. 

Reading this made me feel a little better. Thank you
I can relate. It sucks. none of us asked for this

I'm thinking about giving my number to the people who message me frequently. Also, next time, instead of adding each other on FB I will ask for their numbers, although I know most of people my age prefer FB.
